templates.name: Incident summary
templates.description: Writes a plain-language incident summary with a timeline and next steps.
templates.what_it_does:
Reads the incident and its alerts from PagerDuty.
Reads the related errors from Sentry.
Writes a short summary, a timeline and a severity.
Proposes next steps for the team.

connectors.purpose: Read incidents, alerts and the incident log.
Read the errors and the releases related to the incident.

templates.name: Linear triage
templates.description: Triages new Linear issues. Adds labels and a priority, and asks for missing details.
templates.what_it_does:
Reads each new issue from a request or an email.
Adds labels and a priority from a labeling rubric.
Finds possible duplicates.
Asks the reporter for missing details in a comment.

connectors.purpose: Read issues, add labels and priorities, and write comments.

templates.name: Invoice extractor
templates.description: Extracts structured data from invoice files sent by HTTP or by email.
templates.what_it_does:
Reads each invoice file attached to a request or an email.
Extracts the supplier, the dates, the totals and the line items.
Checks that the line items add up to the total.
Answers the email with a short summary.

templates.name: Meeting actions
templates.description: Turns the meeting notes of each workday into Asana tasks with owners and due dates.
templates.what_it_does:
Runs at 18:00 UTC on each workday.
Reads the meeting notes of the day from Granola.
Finds the action items, the owners and the due dates.
Creates one Asana task for each action item.

connectors.purpose: Read the notes and the transcripts of the meetings of the day.
Find projects and people, and create tasks.

templates.name: Competitor watch
templates.description: Searches the web each week for competitor news and records each finding.
templates.what_it_does:
Runs each Monday at 08:00 UTC.
Searches the web for news about each competitor in its instructions.
Records each new finding with a source and an impact level.
Sends a weekly summary of the most important findings.

connectors.purpose: Search the web and read pages.

templates.name: Lead qualifier
templates.description: Scores a new lead against your ideal customer profile and records the result.
templates.what_it_does:
Reads the company and the contact of a new lead.
Finds the lead in HubSpot. Adds company data from Apollo when it is connected.
Gives a score from 0 to 100 with the reasons.
Saves the result in the lead data store.

connectors.purpose: Find the company and the contact, and read the deal history.
Add company size, industry and funding data.

templates.name: Ticket helper
templates.description: Drafts answers to customer conversations in Intercom for a support agent to review.
templates.what_it_does:
Reads an Intercom conversation and the customer history.
Drafts an answer in the tone of your team.
Asks the support agent a question when facts are missing.
Never sends a message to the customer.

connectors.purpose: Read conversations, contacts and help center articles. Add internal notes.
